# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen to fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bowman family  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden and domestic servant  <sub>[v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

She wears very bright, rampant blue bows tied in her hair, which sometimes resemble overgrown wings sprouting from her neck. For special occasions, she braids her hair into numerous small plaits to make it crinkly, then ties it into two tails with brand-new blue ribbons. Her hands are described as small brown paws, and she wears stiffly starched white dresses for events.

_Sources: [v2 c27 P45](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0045), [v2 c27 P47](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0047), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

She is an extraordinarily dedicated, energetic, and faithful handmaiden who loves Miss Lavendar deeply. Highly practical and literal-minded, she often struggles to understand imaginative grandiloquence and prefers straightforward prose. She is prone to anxiety about future catastrophes and worry over household affairs, yet she works tirelessly and enthusiastically to support those she cares about.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P50](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0050), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v2 c30 P16](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0016), [v2 c30 P22](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0022)_

## History

Charlotta the Fourth, whose real name is Leonora Bowman, came to live at Echo Lodge as a domestic handmaiden for Miss Lavendar Lewis, following in the footsteps of her three elder sisters. Unlike her sisters, she tolerates and never mocks Miss Lavendar's imaginative pretendings. When Anne Shirley and Diana Barry visit Echo Lodge, Charlotta assists in demonstrating the famous woodland echoes by blowing a tin horn and laughing. She worries deeply about Miss Lavendar's health and emotional state, confiding her fears to Anne when Miss Lavendar accidentally cracks a prized pink teacup. When Stephen Irving arrives to reunite with Miss Lavendar, Charlotta demands that Anne explain the situation in plain prose, openly wishing for their marriage so Miss Lavendar will not be left alone when Charlotta eventually leaves for Boston. In the days leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding, Charlotta works frantically to decorate, polish silver, and prepare food while worrying about potential disasters like rain or sudden illnesses. On the wedding day, she dresses in her finest starched gown and crinkly plaited hair, satisfied with her work and relieved that the occasion proceeds smoothly.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P68](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0068), [v2 c21 P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P45](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0045), [v2 c27 P50](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0050), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P50](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0050), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v2 c30 P16](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0016), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual birth name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the fourth and last sister in the Bowman family to work as Miss Lavendar's handmaiden  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Her elder sisters Charlotta, Julietta, and Evelina preceded her in service at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
